    🎙

    StudioYour voice, phrase by phrase

    Tap to record. Speak naturally, the way you would on the street.

      How this works. Record each phrase, then tap Save into the app. You get a new Kannaad-IRL.html with your voice built in. Send that file to learners. Every phone then plays your voice and checks their pronunciation against it, even offline. Takes are kept on this phone until you save, so you can record over several sittings.
